parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift`. Merging them into a generic struct would couple two unrelated test packages (Artwork and Metadata) and add complexity with no production benefit.
